ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.row.preset.label: Preset
ui.settings.row.preset.hint: Sets all values below; your own changes make it “Custom”.
ui.settings.row.renderScale.label: Render scale
ui.settings.row.renderScale.hint: Internal resolution; the HUD stays sharp.
ui.settings.row.shadows.label: Shadows
ui.settings.row.shadows.hint: Blob or cascades (CSM), terrain and props cached statically.
ui.settings.row.splatLayers.label: Terrain textures
ui.settings.row.particleCap.label: Particle cap
ui.settings.row.bloom.label: Glow and afterglow
ui.settings.row.bloom.hint: HDR, bloom. Without bloom, embers stay readable through saturation.
ui.settings.row.antialias.label: Anti-aliasing
ui.settings.row.antialias.hint: FXAA is cheap, MSAA 4× from High.
ui.settings.row.frameCap.label: Frame rate limit
ui.settings.row.frameCap.hint: Monitor = refresh rate of the display.
ui.settings.row.cameraShake.label: Camera shake
ui.settings.row.volMaster.label: Master
ui.settings.row.volSfx.label: Effects
ui.settings.row.volVoice.label: Announcements and acknowledgements
ui.settings.row.volUi.label: Interface
ui.settings.row.volMusic.label: Music
ui.settings.row.volAmbient.label: Ambience
ui.settings.row.alertVoice.label: Alert announcements
ui.settings.row.alertVoice.hint: Gong + voice line; off = text in the alert feed only (P8).
ui.settings.row.audibleStall.label: Audible stall
ui.settings.row.audibleStall.hint: The flow drone tips over during an energy stall.
ui.settings.row.audioInBackground.label: Sound in background tab
ui.settings.row.audioInBackground.hint: Otherwise the game goes silent while the tab is hidden.
ui.settings.row.keyScheme.label: Camera keys
ui.settings.row.keyScheme.hint: “Grid”: letters belong to orders and hotbuild, camera via arrows, edge and middle click. “WASD”: WASD always pans, the grid then needs Alt.
ui.settings.row.teamColors.label: Team colours
ui.settings.row.teamColors.hint: House colours (free choice) · own/enemy (fixed) · colour-blind safe (verified palette of 8).
ui.settings.row.statePatterns.label: State patterns
ui.settings.row.statePatterns.hint: Critical bars and stall displays are also hatched.
ui.settings.row.iconOutline.label: Stronger icon outline
ui.settings.row.iconOutline.hint: Strategic icons with a 3 px instead of 2 px graphite outline.
ui.settings.row.uiScale.label: UI scale
ui.settings.row.reducedMotion.label: Reduce motion
ui.settings.row.reducedMotion.hint: No pulsing, no flashing; states stay readable through frames and symbols.
ui.settings.row.alertFlash.label: Alert flash
ui.settings.row.alertFlash.hint: New critical alerts flash twice; off = calm double frame.
ui.settings.row.alertText.label: Show alerts as text
ui.settings.row.alertText.hint: Every voice line also appears in the alert feed (always on in the MVP).
ui.settings.row.locale.label: Language
ui.settings.row.edgePan.label: Edge panning
ui.settings.row.tooltips.label: Tooltips
ui.settings.row.tooltips.hint: Short = name and cost, full = with stats and adjacency.
ui.settings.row.pauseInBackground.label: Pause in hidden tab
ui.settings.row.autoSaveReplays.label: Save replays automatically
ui.settings.detect.title: Detected automatically: {preset}
ui.settings.load.note: Estimate for the reference laptop (Iris Xe, 1080p), extrapolated from the local measurement (DECISIONS 17).
ui.settings.load.over: Above the budget of {budget} ms GPU.
ui.settings.probe.text: Plays a sample per bus (bell strike, Punch shot, alert gong).
ui.settings.probe.voices: 32 voices, priority: alert ▸ bell ▸ acknowledgement ▸ UI ▸ explosion ▸ weapon.
ui.settings.grid.tiers: Pressing repeatedly only changes the tech tier, never the type.
ui.settings.grid.rebind: Freely bindable keys and profiles: C20 (post-MVP).
ui.settings.legend.note: Labels follow the keyboard layout ({layout}); internally the physical key counts.
ui.settings.combo.caption: Special combinations
ui.settings.combo.groupsNote: or right click / ⇧right click on the group field; Ctrl+number (FA) only with keyboard lock in fullscreen
ui.settings.rebind.title: Free rebinding follows with C20 (post-MVP).
ui.settings.wasdWarn: On Windows, Alt+Shift switches the input language – with builders selected, give orders by mouse instead.
ui.settings.cvd.text: Smallest distance between two colours (ΔE2000) under normal, deutan, protan and tritan vision: {cvd} (house colours: {house}). Slot 1 ↔ 2 (1v1, blue/red): ≥ {pair}; slot 2 stays ≥ {ember} away from ember and warning (orange only from slot 3).
ui.settings.cvd.houseText: House colours suffice in 1v1 (red/blue); in a field of 8 they are not safe for colour-blind players (smallest distance {house}).
ui.settings.cvd.relationText: Own, allied, enemy – independent of the colours chosen in the lobby.
ui.settings.cvd.note: Role and tech always live in shape, glyph and notches – colour only separates houses.
ui.settings.game.text: Texts and unit names come from the string tables (P12). Call name and role are built the same way in both languages:
ui.settings.foot: Settings are stored locally (localStorage) and never travel with replays.
